title: GDD T-118 — Modo kiosco: watchdog, burn-in, soak 8h (§14 operación continua) [gate Hito 5]
description: Production hardening for 8-12 h/day continuous operation on the N100 target (GDD §14). Windows kiosk mode: autologin + launcher watchdog that restarts the app if unresponsive for 10 s; scheduled daily restart at closing time; rotating local log capped at 200 MB. Burn-in prevention: in ATTRACT, all static elements drift ±4 px on a 60 s cycle. Boot-to-ATTRACT <= 40 s from power-on. Hito 5 gate ACs (§17): a remote pool update applies WITHOUT restarting the binary (with TASK-036); a simulated network cut causes zero gameplay degradation; an 8-hour soak run shows flat memory (no leak) and zero crashes. The soak and boot-time measurements need a real Windows machine — coordinate with the human for the target-hardware runs; everything else is scriptable. Read GDD §14 + §17 Hito 5 before coding.
acceptance_criteria: Watchdog restarts the app within budget when it stops responding 10 s (fault-injection test); daily scheduled restart configured and documented
Rotating log with 200 MB cap proven by synthetic log flood
ATTRACT burn-in drift (±4 px, 60 s cycle) applied to all static UI elements
Remote pool update applied end-to-end without binary restart (with TASK-036), verified on a running instance
Simulated network cut mid-operation: session continues undegraded (ties into TASK-036 degraded mode)
8 h soak: memory flat within tolerance, zero crashes, logs rotate — run recorded with the human on target-like hardware (uat-style evidence attached to the ticket)
Boot to ATTRACT <= 40 s measured and recorded on the target machine

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CARRY-IN from TASK-052 review (rev-t052 LOW-1, 2026-07-07): the session loop's economy-data fail-loud policy (PayoutRules.ValidateTable since TASK-051; the coop table shape guard from TASK-052 at SessionStateMachine.cs ~649-655) can throw out of SessionStateMachine.Tick() mid-session on bad economy content. The content validator gates build-pipeline and remote bundles (GDD §11.1), so these throws should be unreachable in production — but GDD §14 unattended operation has NO session-level containment if one escapes: a live cabinet would wedge mid-session. This ticket's watchdog scope must include catch-at-the-driver containment for unhandled exceptions escaping Tick — log + abort-to-attract (session forfeited, cabinet stays alive) — covering the WHOLE existing throw family, not just payout guards. Decide and [ASSUMED]-tag the recovery semantics (players' coins/credits on abort) where the GDD is silent.
